usedFor: Approveit holds internal sign-offs, and you open one with “Create Approval Request” or change one with “Update Approval Request”.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Approval Request” in Approveit
bestTemplate.why: It submits a new request with its form values and approvers, so the sign-off starts at once.

watchOut: “Update Approval Request” changes a pending or sent-back request, so check its state first.
